title: AI Engineer - Generative AI
text:
What you'll do
- Build LLM-powered assistants for customer support teams
- Design prompts, retrieval and evaluation for RAG systems
- Ship Python APIs with FastAPI

What you'll need
- Python (strong)
- Hands-on experience with large language models
- NLP basics: tokenisation, embeddings
- REST API design
- Docker

Nice to have
- MLOps or LLMOps experience
- A cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure)
